propositions: REBAR_OPCERT_PRIVATE_KEY is read into OpcertServiceConfig but never removed from os.environ, leaving it visible to child processes and environment dumps
inline-PEM configuration path inherits the unset variable to spawned subprocesses (ssh-keygen, git) that do not explicitly pass env parameter
os.environ.pop() must be called after capturing the inline PEM value in _private_key_env() to transfer the secret from environment to config object
second call to OpcertServiceConfig.from_env() in same process should return private_key as None to enforce consume-once semantics and prevent silent regressions on future reload paths
deployed production path uses REBAR_OPCERT_KEY_PATH file source only and is unaffected; hardening applies only to secondary dev/compat inline-PEM path
